text_block_list.text:
Seeing Rice Shower holding her head in pain
in the plaza, I called out to her...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my head's been hurting since this morning...
Though it's not quite like a cold, it's more like, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll get better soon,
so please don't worry, Onii-sama...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll get better soon,
so please don't worry, Onee-sama...

Rice Shower seems to be suffering from a headache.
If only there were something I could do for her...
